creative_direction: Portray Nobita Nobi at his familiar school-child age, wearing a plain yellow sweater over a white collar. His round eyeglasses have clear lenses without glare, and one hand touches the outer rim away from the eye. Give him a shy hopeful smile while preserving his recognizable hair and face. Use warm ivory paper and keep both patterned irises readable through the glasses. Use opaque gouache shapes with soft brush edges, paper texture, and restrained shading. Use lavender irises with a few thin concentric rings around visible dark pupils. Confine the rings to the irises, preserving clear highlights and an approachable expression. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
